app.name: Passhopper
app.tagline: Plan your Interrail trip. Make the pass pay off.
app.disclaimer: Passhopper is not affiliated with Interrail / Eurail B.V. Rules and prices are for guidance only; check the official sites.

home.title: Where are you hopping next?
home.emptyBody: Create a trip to plan your route, see which days are worth a travel day, and find out if the pass pays off.

trip.notFoundBody: This trip doesn't exist on this device. It may have been deleted.

wizard.homeRule: In your home country, the pass covers one trip out and one trip back. We work this out for you.
wizard.noHomeRule: If you live outside Europe, the home-country limit doesn't apply.
wizard.returnTo: Come back to {{name}} at the end
wizard.needStop: Add at least one city to visit.

route.title: Route
route.empty: Your route will appear here as a metro-style line, one stop per city.

segment.manualNote: Enter a train you found yourself.
segment.departsNextDay: Leaves after midnight (the day after this journey starts)
segment.badPrice: Enter a price of 0 or more, or leave it empty.
segment.needTimes: Enter both the departure and arrival time.
segment.arriveAfter: The arrival must be after the departure. For a night train, tick “Arrives the next day”.
segment.deleteConfirm: Delete this train from the journey?

days.title: Travel days
days.empty: Once you add trains, we'll suggest which days to use your pass on.
days.flipHint: Flip a switch and the total updates
days.reasonHome: Stays inside {{country}}, your home country, so the pass doesn't cover it
days.reasonHomeSecond: Your pass covers only one trip out of and one trip back into your home country
days.reasonOperator: The pass isn't valid on this train
days.addPrice: Add a ticket price to compare
days.ticketInstead: Ticket {{price}}; the pass would save only {{save}}
days.errTooMany: You picked {{used}} travel days, but this pass has {{allowed}}.
days.errValidity: Your first and last travel days are {{span}} days apart, longer than the pass's {{allowed}}-day validity.
days.errNightLast: A night train on {{date}} starts on the pass's last valid day, which isn't allowed.
days.lockedHint: The pass can't be used on this day

seats.title: Seat reservations
seats.empty: Trains that need a seat reservation will be listed here.
seats.notIncluded: Reservations aren't included in the pass and cost extra.
seats.notIncludedVaries: Reservations aren't included in the pass. Some prices vary, so the total may be higher.
seats.quotaNote: Pass holders get a limited number of seats on this train. Book early.
seats.allBooked: All the seats you need are booked.

savings.title: Savings
savings.empty: We'll compare every pass option with buying tickets, and show what you save.
savings.ticketsWin: Buying tickets is cheaper by {{amount}} at typical fares
savings.isBest: The cheapest pass for this trip, compared with buying every ticket at typical fares
savings.stillSaves: Even at the cheapest advance fares, the pass still saves {{amount}}.
savings.advanceFares: If you get the cheapest advance fare on every train, tickets would cost {{amount}} less. Those fares sell early and usually can't be changed, so the pass is more flexible if your plans might shift.
savings.flipCheaper: The answer depends most on {{train}}: if you find it for {{price}}, {{winner}} becomes the cheapest option.
savings.flipPricier: The answer depends most on {{train}}: if it costs {{price}}, {{winner}} becomes the cheapest option.
savings.missing_one: {{count}} train has no price yet and counts as €0. Add its price on the Route page.
savings.missing_other: {{count}} trains have no price yet and count as €0. Add their prices on the Route page.
savings.tapToSwitch: tap a pass to use it
savings.unpriced_one: {{count}} more pass isn't shown because we don't have its price for you yet.
savings.unpriced_other: {{count}} more passes aren't shown because we don't have their prices for you yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataNote: Your trips are saved in this browser on this device only. Export a file to back them up or move them to another device.
settings.importNotJson: That file isn't valid JSON. Choose a file exported from Passhopper.
settings.importInvalid: That file isn't a Passhopper export, or it's from a newer version.
settings.deleteAllConfirm: This deletes every trip on this device. You can't undo it, so export first if you might need them.

pass.missingPrices_one: Add the price for {{count}} train to make this more accurate
pass.missingPrices_other: Add prices for {{count}} trains to make this more accurate
pass.noPrices: We don't have pass prices for {{age}}, {{cls}} yet, so we can't plan travel days. Check interrail.eu for the price.

rules.unverified: Reservation fees were checked against interrail.com on 4 Nov 2026. Pass prices are estimates. Confirm both before you book.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.setupBody: The assistant uses your own key from DeepSeek, Claude or another provider. It stays in this browser, and you only pay your provider for what you use. Everything else in Passhopper works without it.
ai.emptyTitle: How should we change your trip?
ai.canChange: Add cities, move days, find trains
ai.canExplain: Explain travel days, reservations and costs
ai.canSearch: Check the web for strikes and changes
ai.privacy: Only cities, dates, trains and your age group and class are sent to your AI provider.
ai.sugAddCity: Add 2 nights in a new city
ai.sugSeats: Which trains need a seat reservation?
ai.sugNews: Any strikes or works on my route?

state.failed: The trip changed since this was suggested. Ask again.

ai.chMoved: {{name}} moves to a new place in the route

err.key: Your API key was not accepted. Check it in Settings.
err.balance: Your AI account is out of credit. Top it up with your provider.
err.rate: Too many requests right now. Wait a moment and try again.
err.model: That model isn't available for your key. Check the model name in Settings.
err.network: Couldn't reach the AI provider. Check your connection, or the provider may not allow calls from a browser.
err.refusal: The model declined to answer this. Try asking another way.
err.other: Something went wrong with the AI provider.

about.deepseek: Low cost, and works from mainland China. Includes web search.
about.claude: Strong at planning. Searches the web with Claude's own search tool.
about.custom: Any service with an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API that allows calls from a browser.

ai.customSearch: To let this provider search the web, also save a DeepSeek key under DeepSeek.
ai.keyNote: Your key is stored only in this browser and sent only to your provider, directly from this device. Passhopper has no server. Don't save a key on a shared computer.

search.failed: Couldn't load the timetable. Check your connection and try again, or enter the train by hand.
search.noPlace: We couldn't find a station for this city. Enter the train by hand.
search.none: No trains found for this time. Try a different time of day.
search.sample: The timetable for your date isn't published yet, so these are the trains on {{date}}. Times rarely change much; check again closer to your trip.
search.replaces: Picking an option replaces the trains already on this leg.

conflict.overlap: {{next}} leaves before {{prev}} arrives. Check the times.
conflict.tight_one: Only {{count}} minute to change from {{prev}} to {{next}}.
conflict.tight_other: Only {{count}} minutes to change from {{prev}} to {{next}}.
conflict.manyChanges_one: {{count}} change on this journey. Look for a more direct train.
conflict.manyChanges_other: {{count}} changes on this journey. Look for a more direct train.
conflict.longDay: {{time}} of travel in one day. Consider a night train or a stop on the way.
conflict.missed: You pass through {{name}} without staying, but the next train leaves before this one arrives.

draft.title: Describe your trip
draft.placeholder: 3 weeks from Berlin in July, Italy and Switzerland, not too rushed
draft.done: Here's a first route. Change anything below.
draft.nothing: The AI didn't suggest a route. Try describing it differently.
draft.noKey: Want to describe your trip in one sentence? Add an AI key first.

note.title: Notes
note.label: Where you stay, what to do
note.placeholder: Hostel near the station. Uffizi tickets for Friday 10:00.

aiPrice.none: The AI didn't give a price. Try again or enter it yourself.
